safety.title:
Small Safety Habits.
A Safer Plant.
safety.lead: Simple routine checks keep every LPG-powered commercial and industrial site safe.
safety.imageAlt: Technician in safety gear inspecting a commercial LPG cylinder manifold
safety.panelTitle: Four checks for a safer site
safety.panelSubtitle: Quick preventive habits every commercial LPG user should follow.

steps.title: Keep It Upright
steps.description: Place every cylinder vertically on a stable, level and ventilated surface.

steps.title: Inspect Connections
steps.description: Check regulators, manifold headers and hoses at regular intervals.

steps.title: Allow Ventilation
steps.description: Keep the cylinder bank area airy and never block ventilation points.

steps.title: Respond Correctly
steps.description: Shut the valve and call authorized support immediately if leakage is suspected.
